description: GET /v1/merchants/me/balance/statement.pdf - saves the Live statement of one UTC calendar month (opening and closing balance, top-ups, charges by chain) as a PDF file in a local directory and returns its path. A month becomes available about an hour after it closes; an earlier request is refused with the time it opens. Live only - Test has no monetary statement; export its estimates with paymaster_balance_charges_export. Uses the cached sk_live_ key, else a fresh JWT.

directory.description: Absolute path of an existing local directory to save the file into. An existing file is never overwritten.

name: paymaster_balance_statement_export
title: Save a monthly statement as a PDF file
